text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Foot Ulcer with superimposed cellulitis. The clinical picture of a chronic, non-healing wound on the right lower leg in a patient with likely diabetes (suggested by the extensive workup), combined with signs of inflammation, strongly points to this diagnosis. Further imaging like an MRI may be needed to rule out osteomyelitis if bone exposure is confirmed, but the primary treatment plan should focus on offloading, debridement, infection control, and glycemic management.
